choices: Parsed einzelkanal-ausschluss.json by checking common JSON structures (list of strings/dicts or dict with known exclusion keys or per-item mapping) because its exact schema was not specified in the preregistration.
Defined a complete seed as having all 12 items present in both models across all 8 cells with non-null 'verdict' (and boolean 'looked_up'), removing any seed with a missing verdict from both models.
Sorted valid items lexicographically by item 'id' before bootstrap resampling so that fixed random seeds produce deterministic bootstrap draws.
Averaged C2 over AUSKUNFT (AU=0 and AU=1) within SPEC=1, matching C1 and the standard cell-contrast definition.
Used random.Random(seed).choices(values, k=len(values)) for bootstrap resampling and computed one-sided p-values as the proportion of bootstrap means <= 0.
